categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai MicroPort Endovascular MedTech (Group) Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the research, development, production, and sales of high-end medical devices focused on aortic and peripheral vascular interventional medical devices. Its main product lines include aortic covered stent systems, peripheral balloon dilation catheters, peripheral vascular stent systems, embolization coils, vena cava filters, filter retrievers, and intraoperative stent systems. The company also engages in tumor intervention devices through peripheral vascular intervention.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses proprietary core technologies in the design and manufacturing of covered stent systems for aortic diseases, including branch stent fabrication, ultra-low profile delivery systems, multi-branch stent release technologies, laser engraving for precise stent shaping, and drug coating technologies for sustained release. It also develops advanced catheter and filter technologies with features like anti-entanglement structures, integrated release and retrieval functions, and high-performance balloon catheters with composite fiber materials. Production adheres to stringent quality management standards such as YY/T0287-2017 and ISO13485:2016.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's primary customers are hospitals and medical institutions across China and internationally, including over 2400 domestic hospitals and coverage in 40 countries. It serves cardiovascular intervention markets focusing on aortic and peripheral vascular diseases, as well as tumor intervention. Key customers include major hospitals and distributors, with the top five customers accounting for over 70% of sales. The company also targets second to fourth-tier cities and populous counties to expand market penetration.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, covering all 31 provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities, with significant penetration in domestic hospitals. Internationally, it has expanded into Europe, Latin America, Asia-Pacific, and other regions, with products approved and implanted in countries such as Colombia, Greece, Belgium, South Korea, Uzbekistan, Belarus, and Brazil. Overseas sales accounted for over 13% of total revenue in 2024, showing rapid growth.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai MicroPort Endovascular MedTech operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the medical device supply chain. It conducts independent procurement of raw materials, in-house manufacturing of medical devices, and sales through a distributor network to hospitals. The company manages its own R&D, production, quality control, and marketing, positioning itself as a manufacturer and supplier of high-value interventional medical devices.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous innovation and R&D investment, focusing on developing advanced aortic and peripheral vascular intervention devices with proprietary technologies. Strategic R&D priorities include multi-branch stent systems for complex aortic arch diseases, drug-coated balloons and stents to reduce restenosis, and tumor intervention devices. It actively pursues domestic and international regulatory approvals (NMPA, CE, FDA) and aims to enhance product portfolios in peripheral arterial, venous, and tumor intervention fields. The company also invests in talent development and intellectual property protection.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of medical devices, including proprietary products and agency products, to distributors and hospitals. The company uses a buyout distribution model, recognizing revenue upon transfer of control to customers. Sales are segmented by domestic and international markets, with additional revenue from government subsidies and investment income. The company also engages in direct sales in some overseas markets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in the aortic and peripheral vascular interventional medical device market in China, holding the largest market share among domestic brands. It competes with multinational corporations such as Medtronic, Boston Scientific, Abbott, and Gore, which dominate the peripheral vascular segment. Shanghai MicroPort Endovascular MedTech is recognized for its innovation and has achieved significant import substitution in China, positioning itself as a strong competitor with growing international presence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total revenue of approximately RMB 1.206 billion, representing a 1.61% increase over the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 502 million, up 1.96%. The company maintains a strong gross margin around 73%, with R&D investment accounting for 14% of revenue. Overseas sales nearly doubled, contributing over 13% of revenue. The company has a registered capital of RMB 123 million and total assets exceeding RMB 4.29 billion, reflecting steady growth and expanding scale.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers innovative, high-quality interventional medical devices with proprietary technologies that address complex aortic and peripheral vascular diseases. Its products feature advanced design elements such as ultra-low profile delivery systems, multi-branch stents for aortic arch repair, and drug-coated balloons to reduce restenosis. The company emphasizes affordability and accessibility, contributing to import substitution and reducing patient burden. It also provides comprehensive academic and clinical training platforms to support product adoption and improve clinical outcomes.
